import json, os
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
TZ=timezone(timedelta(hours=8))
day='2026-10-27'
paths=[
 os.path.expanduser('~/Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/state/youchu_ai_inbox.jsonl'),
 os.path.expanduser('~/Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/state/sent.json'),
]
# also try alternate sent
for p in [
 os.path.expanduser('~/Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/state/youchu_ai_outbox.jsonl'),
 os.path.expanduser('~/Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/state/sent.jsonl'),
]:
  if os.path.exists(p): paths.append(p)

for p in paths:
  if not os.path.exists(p):
    print('MISS', p); continue
  print('===', p, '===')
  n=0
  with open(p,'r',encoding='utf-8',errors='replace') as f:
    for line in f:
      line=line.strip()
      if not line: continue
      try: o=json.loads(line)
      except: continue
      # time fields
      ts=o.get('created_at') or o.get('ts') or o.get('time') or o.get('timestamp') or ''
      if isinstance(ts,(int,float)):
        try: ts=datetime.fromtimestamp(ts/1000 if ts>1e12 else ts, TZ).isoformat()
        except: ts=str(ts)
      ts=str(ts)
      if day not in ts and not ts.startswith(day.replace('-','')):
        # also check text
        text=json.dumps(o,ensure_ascii=False)
        if day not in text and '10-27' not in text and '10/27' not in text:
          continue
      kind=o.get('kind') or o.get('type') or ''
      bid=o.get('bus_id') or o.get('id') or o.get('reply_to_bus_id') or ''
      text=(o.get('text') or o.get('body') or o.get('content') or o.get('message') or '')
      if isinstance(text,dict): text=json.dumps(text,ensure_ascii=False)
      text=str(text).replace('\n',' ')[:180]
      print(f'{ts[:19]} kind={kind} bus={bid} | {text}')
      n+=1
      if n>=80: break
  print('count_shown',n)
